subject: general
question: Harela is a festival of greenery, peace, prosperity, and environmental conservation, primarily celebrated in which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttarakhand**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Harela is** a festival of greenery, peace, prosperity, and environmental conservation that is primarily celebrated in Uttarakhand and some regions of Himachal Pradesh**: 
 
• **Uttarakhand**
 
 
• Harela is a **significant part of Uttarakhand's culture and traditions.**
 
• It is **celebrated with great enthusiasm and marks the beginning of the monsoon season.**
 
• During Harela, communities come together to plant trees and honor the harmony between humans and the environment. 
 
 
 
• **Himachal Pradesh**
 
 
• Harela is **celebrated in some regions of Himachal Pradesh, particularly in the Kumaun region.**
 
• In the **Kangra, Shimla, and Sirmour regions of Himachal Pradesh, it is called Hariyali or Rihyali.**
 
• In the Jubbal and Kinnaur areas of Himachal Pradesh, it is called Dakhrain
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Some f**estivals celebrated in Madhya Pradesh, Haryana, and Assam include:**

 
 
• **Bhagoriya:** A festival celebrated by the tribal people of Madhya Pradesh 
 
• **Bohag Bihu: **A festival celebrated in Assam that marks the beginning of spring and the Assamese New Year 
 
• **Tusu Puja:** A festival celebrated by Assam's tea tribes to honor Goddess Tusu Devi 
 
• **Surajkund International Crafts Mela: **A festival celebrated in Haryana 
 
• **Mango Mela: **A festival celebrated in Haryana 
 
• **Baisakhi Mela:** A festival celebrated in Haryana 
 
• **Pinjore Heritage Festival**: A festival celebrated in Haryana 
 
• **International Gita Mahotsav: **A festival celebrated in Haryana
